The long way home.

Synthetic review: We followed the river path until the light began to soften. We stopped for bread at the little bakery and sat on a bench while it was still warm.

There was no rush to leave. The afternoon turned into a few hours of walking, talking, and noticing the things we usually pass by.

A quiet chapter.

Synthetic review: Read on the porch until the light went gold.

An afternoon together.

Synthetic review: Everyone brought something for lunch, and we moved the table into the shade. We talked so long that the tea went cold.

I want to remember the sound of the garden and the way nobody seemed to be in a hurry.

Small things, kept.
